name: Maggot Eye's Paw
summary: At Garren's Haunt, Maggot Eye's Paw proves the gnoll chieftain is dead. The paw is carried to Brill as proof of his execution for stealing corpses for the Scourge.

sections.title: Proof of Execution
sections.body: Maggot Eye raided graves and pillaged the countryside near Garren's Haunt, supplying corpses to the Lich King's armies. The Forsaken posted a death sentence and bounty in Brill. To collect the bounty and close it, hunters must bring the gnoll's severed paw back to town. Executor Zygand accepts that proof in place of rumors of Maggot Eye's death.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want Maggot Eye's paw?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand wants Maggot Eye's paw as proof that the condemned gnoll has been killed. Brill pays the bounty once the execution is confirmed.

faq.q: What crimes did Maggot Eye commit against the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Maggot Eye led raids across northern Tirisfal Glades and stole buried corpses from farmsteads such as Garren's Haunt. He supplied them to the Lich King's armies.
Maggot Eye is found at Garren's Haunt, a ruined farmstead north of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He usually lurks inside the ruined farmhouse.

faq.q: Why are gnolls working with the Lich King's forces?
faq.answer: In Tirisfal Glades, rogue gnoll bands have allied with or fallen under the Scourge's sway. They raid human and Forsaken graves to deliver bodies to necromancers.

angles.text: As a Forsaken of Brill, bringing back Maggot Eye's paw strikes at the body thieves who supply the hated Lich King.
